subject: Operational evidence & DPA annex — Ember Systems RFI: cross-border / DPF needs
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@embersys.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@embersys.com>, procurement@embersys.com
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Ember Systems RFI follow-up — operational controls for cross-border transfers (DPF)

Jordan — thanks again for the call this morning. Ember Systems is compiling the final security/evidence bundle for our vendor selection committee and we need a compact set of operational artifacts and a suggested DPA annex focused on cross-border safeguards. To be specific, could you provide the following: 

- A short operations pack describing how Redwood implements DPF-like safeguards for EU->US and APAC transfers (technical controls, logging, retention)
- A draft DPA annex (redlines acceptable) that includes transfer mechanisms we can present to legal (SCCs/DPF references and fallback language)
- Confirmation on customer-managed encryption keys (KMS/HSM) and whether key residency is supported
- A list of subprocessors and any planned changes in the next 6 months
- SOC 2 report and most recent penetration-test summary (links or redacted PDF acceptable)

Our timeline: procurement review next Tuesday 2027-05-04; ideally we need deliverables by EOD Monday 2027-05-03 to circulate. If there are items you cannot provide, please flag them and propose an operational mitigation.

Appreciate it — feel free to loop in anyone on your side who should see this.

Samir Patel
Head of Security & Compliance
Ember Systems

[Attachment: Ember-RFI-template.xlsx (XLSX, 120KB)]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@embersys.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 01 May 2027 09:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Ember Systems RFI follow-up — operational controls for cross-border transfers (DPF)

Hi Samir — thanks for the clear list. We're attaching an operations pack and a draft DPA annex to this reply (see attachments). High-level answers inline and next steps below.

Quick answers:
- Customer-managed keys: supported (Cloud KMS integrations + HSM-backed options). We can support CMK in AWS (KMS) and bring-your-own-key models for Dedicated/Private deployments.
- Subprocessors: a current list is included; we anticipate no planned changes in the next 6 months.
- SOC 2: here's a link to our latest Type II report (redacted) in the ops pack. PT summary included.
- Transfer mechanisms: we support SCCs and have a DPA annex template that references transfer safeguards compliant with the DPF framework.

Attachments in this email:
- redwood-dpf-operations-pack.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB) — includes system architecture diagrams, logging/retention controls, KV cache behavior and pseudonymization notes
- dpa-annex-proposed-wording.docx (DOCX, 48KB) — suggested language, including fallback routing and data residency options

Clarifying Qs for Ember Systems so we can tailor the annex: 
1) Which data classes do you require to stay in-region? (PII, health data, logs, embeddings?)
2) Do you plan to use Redwood Hosted (API) or Dedicated/Private? Customer-managed keys are available only for Dedicated/Private and VPC Private deployments.
3) Any special regulator/authority we should include in the annex (eg. CNIL, UK ICO, JPIPA)?

Proposed next steps: 
- If you confirm data classes and deployment mode by EOD 2027-05-02, we will produce a final annex and a short CMK/HSM appendix by 2027-05-03.
- I cc'd Marissa (legal ops) and Ben (security) to review the annex and confirm technical wording.

Regards,
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive — Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: redwood-dpf-operations-pack.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)]
[Attachment: dpa-annex-proposed-wording.docx (DOCX, 48KB)]

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@embersys.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@embersys.com>, procurement@embersys.com
Date: Sun, 02 May 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Ember Systems RFI follow-up — operational controls for cross-border transfers (DPF)

Jordan — thanks for the quick turn. A few clarifications from legal and infra: 

- Primary data classes: persistent PII (customer profiles), health-related metadata, and the derived embeddings used for search/ranking. Logs and metrics can be aggregated but we need retention controls and deletion processes for requestable user data.
- Preferred deployment: initially Hosted API for POC, then Dedicated if we proceed to production. We will require CMK for production (Dedicated) and want to understand options for key escrow/bring-your-own-key.
- Regions of concern: EU (Ireland), US (East), and Japan. The annex should include explicit language about EU->US transfers and a fallback for Japan via regional routing or on-prem stance.
- We will need an assurance around access to access logs/audit trails spanning at least 12 months and a confirmation that KMS logs can be exported to our SIEM for Dedicated instances.

If you can confirm those items and provide the updated annex with CMK wording, Ember procurement can review on Monday (2027-05-03) and legal will look at the annex on Tuesday.

Samir

> On Sat, May 1, 2027 at 09:41, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com> wrote:
> > [Attachment: redwood-dpf-operations-pack.pdf]
> > [Attachment: dpa-annex-proposed-wording.docx]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@embersys.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 14:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Ember Systems RFI follow-up — operational controls for cross-border transfers (DPF)

Samir — looping in with the annex updates you asked for. Please find attached a targeted supplement and a short technical summary for the CMK/HSM options. Key points below and changes from the original annex: 

- CMK/HSM support: we added explicit language that Dedicated and Private deployments support customer-managed keys. For Hosted API, we offer bring-your-own-key for encryption-at-rest via a customer KMS integration on dedicated instances; Hosted does not support isolated HSMs. Wording added: "Customer may elect KMS key ownership for Dedicated or Private deployments and may require HSM-backed keys for high-risk data classes."
- Audit and logs: we revised Section 3.2 to state 12 months of audit log retention by default for Dedicated, with export hooks (Syslog/S3 + SIEM integration). Hosted customers can request 12-month retention under SOC/Enterprise contract.
- Regional routing & fallback: added routing policy language for EU and Japan; if latency/capacity constraints require cross-border routing, Redwood will use SCCs + documented technical mitigations (prefix-key caching, pseudonymization), and will provide written notice 30 days prior. 

Attachments: 
- dpa-annex-proposed-wording.docx (updated) — includes all redlines and the CMK paragraphs you requested
- redwood-cmk-hsm-summary.pdf (PDF, 220KB) — technical appendix describing KMS integrations, HSM usage, and log export options

Ben, any additional security attestations we should surface here?

Thanks — Marissa Cole
Legal & Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: dpa-annex-proposed-wording.docx (DOCX, 51KB)]
[Attachment: redwood-cmk-hsm-summary.pdf (PDF, 220KB)]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, procurement@embersys.com
Date: Tue, 04 May 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Ember Systems RFI follow-up — operational controls for cross-border transfers (DPF)

Samir — great to align. Per Marissa's update, attached are the final annex and the CMK/HSM summary. We are ready to execute the annex with the proposed CMK language. Next operational items: 

1) DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/embeds/sign?envelopeId=0a1b2c3d — this envelope contains the DPA + Annex with the CMK paragraph.
2) Evidence delivery: redwood-dpf-operations-pack.pdf remains available in the shared Drive (link below) and I've given your team viewer access to the SOC 2 redaction.
3) Technical onboarding: if you accept the annex we will schedule a Dedicated onboarding call to configure KMS key exchange and audit export. Proposed window: 2027-05-10 to 2027-05-14.

Please let me know if procurement needs any additional supporting docs for the Monday review. Happy to jump on a 30-minute call if that helps.

Thanks — Jordan
Senior Account Executive — Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
